subject: Checking the earlier request
text:
I realized I may have made the earlier note unclear, so I wanted to check one thing before anything gets set this week. The question you asked was about which date mattered more, and honestly I flipped around after talking with the other households.

At first I said the yard help was the priority because the gate needs fixing before the contractor comes. But now the indoor work seems more urgent since the hallway light went out and people are tripping in the dark.

If I misunderstood what you had in mind, just tell me. I can do the small items either way, but I would rather know which piece comes first. Sorry this is jumping around; the plan shifted after I saw the quote.
